model: frozen safe_population plus L2 conditional-logit residual; global and phase-specific move attributes and 128 hashed current-position/move opening features
selection: Development-player validation only: lowest macro style TV among penalties with NLL no worse than population, exact/top3 within 1 percentage point; ties by NLL then larger regularization. No eligible penalty means no confirmation scoring.
confirmation: Last 10 accepted players are unseen to hyperparameter selection; score their last 100 games once after selection is sealed. Their middle 100 games are unused. First 20 players' last 100 games stay untouched.
promotion: Require paired-player 95% upper bound below zero for personal-minus-shared and personal-minus-wrong style TV, NLL no worse than shared, exact/top3 within 1pp. At least 8 supported confirmation players with valid same-300-game donor histories. Passing replay gates is not full clone promotion: engine quality and generated-game tests remain required.
sampling: First 30 eligible players from fixed opponent-discovery ordering excluding prior targets; newest 500 eligible unique whole games, chronological 300/100/100; reject tied split boundaries. Old and shared games excluded; no decision cap.
scope: Retrospective unseen-target study, not globally prospective: frozen backbone/shared-adapter history may postdate another player's evaluation dates. Only personal and wrong-player histories must precede the target evaluation. No full-game opening labels, results, clocks or engine labels used as inputs.
